title: Nyakati na Hali (Theme 4: Matumizi bora ya maliasili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses hu- (no person prefix) for a habit and -me- for an action complete and still true now, and uses them in a passage.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "hupanda" and "Wamepanda miti mia moja mwaka huu."

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Katika "Huenda sokoni kila siku", hali ni ipi?" Kwa nini "timilifu" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Katika "Amefika", hali ni ipi?" Kwa nini "ya mazoea" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Katika "Alifika", ni hali gani?" Kwa nini "timilifu" si jibu sahihi?
Ni jambo la mara moja au la mazoea?
misconceptions.repair: Jambo la mazoea hutumia hu-: kila Jumamosi hufua.

checks.question: Jaza: Ng'ombe ___ (kunywa) maji jioni kila siku.
